name: How long does a typical window leak repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window leak repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window leak repair depends on the complexity of the issue. Simple fixes, such as re-caulking or replacing weatherstripping, might take a few hours. More involved repairs, like addressing significant frame damage or underlying structural water damage, could extend to a full day or even multiple days if custom parts are needed or extensive drying is required. We strive for efficient repairs while ensuring thoroughness to prevent recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies. Simple fixes like re-caulking take a few hours. Complex repairs for significant frame or structural damage can take a full day or several days.
